title: Repairing Damage on the Green
question: On the putting green, which types of damage can you repair without penalty?
explanation: You are permitted to fix pitch-marks, spike marks, and old hole plugs, but not aeration holes or natural imperfections.
imagePrompt: A teenage boy using a repair tool to fix a pitch mark next to his ball on the putting green.
imageAlt: Teen boy repairing a pitch mark beside his golf ball on the putting green.

imageVerification.repairPrompt: No repair necessary. All scene and equipment elements are correct and visually strong.
